courses.name: Newgreens Chatswood
courses.notes: 12 holes, par 44, 2,871 m off the standard tees. Lengths in metres; tee sets: standard (the club's card prints one distance column and names no tee colour, so it is called standard here). No handicap rating stored (the club's course page says Course Rating: TBC). The course was rebuilt and reopened in May 2026 as Newgreens Chatswood, Australia's first purpose-built 12-hole course, on Chatswood Golf Club's own ground (130 Beaconsfield Road) in an alliance between the club, Pariter and Watermark Living; the old 17th became the new 11th. This record was Chatswood Golf Club's 18-hole card (Golfify, par 65, 4,372 m black), replaced here by the new club card, so it keeps its id: rounds keep their own card copy. The course map (chatswood) is OpenStreetMap's old layout and won't match these 12 holes until the hole-maps chat rebuilds it; leave it unlinked.
courses.source: Card: the club's scorecard, Newgreens_Golf-Scorecard_March_2026.pdf (newgreenschatswood.com.au, read 2026-10-30): par, index and distance per hole, totals par 44 and 2,871 m, which the holes add to; the course page (newgreenschatswood.com.au/golf/the-course/, read 2026-10-30) agrees on 12 holes, par 44, 2,871 m, and on holes 2 (par 5, 464 m), 3 (par 3, 183 m) and 11 (par 4, 238 m). booking: web search of 2026-10-29 (inferred from directory listings, not the club, https://www.agfg.com.au/article/dodici-and-tempo-tee-off-at-sydneys-bold-new-lifestyle-destination-newgreens-chatswood); booking corrected 2026-10-30 from the club's Tee Times & Rates page (newgreenschatswood.com.au/golf/tee-times-and-rates/, seen): open to the public, its Book a round button is the MiClub calendar stored here, and the fees are its visitor green fees. Location: the course map's origin (OpenStreetMap way/181570673, ODbL, © OpenStreetMap contributors).
courses.bookingNote: Open to the public, booked online. Twilight $39 midweek, $49 weekends; students $35 (Mon–Thu); 16 and under $25. Carts $45 (twilight $30). Pro shop (02) 9419 2336. About 3 hours for 12 holes.
